media: Every man needs time to reflect on the days that have passed by quickly
The day started early when the man realized time was running out for completion
Time flies so fast that every man loses track of days passing by unnoticed
A wise man once said that time and day are the most precious gifts given
Every time the man chose faith over fear his days became filled with hope
larga: The wise old man sat quietly reflecting on how many days had passed since he first understood that time was the most precious commodity any man could possess in his entire lifetime of experiences
Day after day the young man worked tirelessly in the fields wondering if there would ever come a time when he could rest and enjoy the fruits of his labor without worrying about tomorrow's sunrise
Every man who has lived long enough knows that time has a peculiar way of speeding up with each passing day making the years feel like months and the months feel like mere weeks
The successful man realized too late that all the time he spent chasing money and power had cost him precious days with his family who needed his presence more than his provisions ever could

The time had come for the man to stop deferring his dreams to retirement and start living them today because tomorrow was promised to no man and the only time that truly existed was the present moment

media: People around the world gather at night to hear god's word spoken clearly
My friend stood by my side when I needed to face the difficult world
The night brings peace to people who trust in god's word and divine plan
Every part of the world has people searching for god's face in the darkness
A true friend stays by your side through the darkest night without any hesitation
Part of friendship means helping people see god's face in the darkness of night
larga: In this vast and complex world people search for meaning through god's word while friends stand by their side offering support and comfort during the darkest hours of the night when doubts and fears threaten to overwhelm

Every night when the world grows quiet and people rest their weary heads true friends gather together to study god's word and discuss how his divine plan affects every part of their lives and the lives of those they love

The face of god shines upon the world bringing hope to people who have lost their way and desperately need a friend to guide them through the night towards the light of his eternal word and everlasting love
My best friend stood by my side through the longest night of my life when the weight of the world pressed down on my head and only god's word brought comfort to my troubled heart and anxious mind

The night brings divine appointments as god's word connects people who need each other while friends discover that their paths crossed at exactly the right moment to fulfill heaven's purposes in the world
